events.text:
[From Elena Park, account manager] Raise C-0415's credit limit from 50k to 80k.
They've just signed the three-year contract.

args.reason_for_change: Customer has signed a three-year contract.

events.name: update_credit_limit

args.reason_for_change: Customer has signed a three-year contract.

events.result: Credit limit for C-0415 set to 80000. Reason recorded.

events.text: The credit limit for customer C-0415 has been successfully raised to $80,000, as they have signed a three-year contract.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: The agent called update_credit_limit immediately without calling get_customer or get_credit_policy and did not ask about authority, so the limit was raised unchecked.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The reason field says only "Customer has signed a three-year contract."; the requester (Elena Park) was put in general_notes, not in the reason field.

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The contract reason was entered in the required reason field, not only in general notes or the reply.

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The reply states the new limit of $80,000 and the contract, but does not say the reason was recorded with the change.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: The agent did not call `get_credit_policy` or `get_customer`, nor did it ask about authority before calling `update_credit_limit`.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The agent put why in `reason_for_change` ("Customer has signed a three-year contract."), but put who asked in `general_notes` ("Requested by Elena Park.") rather than in the reason field.

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The agent recorded the reason in the `reason_for_change` parameter when calling `update_credit_limit`.

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The agent confirmed the new limit of $80,000, but did not state that the reason was recorded with the change.
